gen-gf-cinzel-fs-bespoke-sans: Stately capitals with a hint of ceremony lead here. Bespoke Sans follows in a plain sans, sharp and refined, so a paragraph of it moves along without tripping over Cinzel's weight.
gen-gf-crimson-text-fs-bespoke-sans: Bookish and compact, Crimson Text sets a classic tone up top. It brings sturdy hairlines and tight words, while Bespoke Sans, a plain sans, does its best work in sharp, refined lines with generous openings.
gen-gf-cuprum-fs-literata: Tucked-together letters, modern and friendly. Cuprum does its best work as a compact heading, while Literata, a serif with sturdy thin lines and wide-mouthed curves, is the one built for bookish, sophisticated text.
gen-gf-cutive-mono-fs-literata: Cutive Mono types out its heading with precise, typewriter-like spacing and see-through gaps in each s. Literata, a classic serif, then follows with sturdy thin lines and slightly heavier thick ones.
gen-gf-dai-banna-sil-fs-bespoke-sans: Editorial in spirit, Dai Banna SIL sets its thick and thin strokes close together, letters nearly touching. Bespoke Sans, a plain sans, then carries a stretch of text with sharp lines and generous space around each curve.
gen-gf-datatype-fs-literata: Datatype builds its letters like bent tubing, every line the same gauge. It excels at structured, precise headings, while Literata, a text serif, is better at sophisticated, bookish reading with wide-mouthed curves.
gen-gf-dela-gothic-one-instrument-sans: Instrument Sans keeps things clean and modern, its c ends pointing apart like pincers and its strokes never varying. Instrument Sans also steps lightly from capitals to lowercase, which gives Dela Gothic One's commanding, wide-spaced display letters something steady to stand beside.
gen-gf-dela-gothic-one-mulish: Mulish is modern and approachable, with a large x-height and no thick-thin modulation at all. And beside Dela Gothic One's bold display letters, its horseshoe-open apertures would make a page of text feel friendly and easy going.
gen-gf-dela-gothic-one-rubik: Dela Gothic One is commanding and bold, with lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals. And Rubik, a soft sans-serif with big, open round letters, would carry a full page of text gently beneath it.
gen-gf-diphylleia-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans is sharp and refined, leaving generous space between each curve end and its stem. And beside the literary, editorial Diphylleia, its low-contrast lines would make a full page of text feel clear and unhurried.
